D: A lonely trash-compacting robot follows a sleek probe robot into space and changes the fate of humanity.
P: Serve the snacks when Wall-E opens his lunchbox at the end of the day.
S: the cooler he uses to carry home his treasures
Little ham and cheddar sandwiches, apple slices tossed in lemon, cheese cubes and crackers packed neatly into a metal lunchbox, a different treasure in each corner.
the little green plant he keeps in an old boot
Pea, edamame and mint dip with a squeeze of lemon, served in a clean boot-shaped bowl or mug, a sprig of herbs sticking out.
the cubes of compacted rubbish he stacks into towers
Butter and marshmallows melted slowly together, puffed rice stirred through, pressed into a lined tray, set an hour, cut into neat cubes and stacked into towers.
M: the cruise ship where everyone drinks their meals
A thick roast pumpkin and red lentil soup with ginger and coconut, served in big mugs with a straw. Grilled cheese on the side for the humans who remember chewing.
the plant that means Earth can grow again
Roasted carrots, beetroot, sweet potato and red onion with garlic and thyme, over herbed couscous with feta.
W: the little sponge cake he finds in the rubbish
Eggs and sugar whisked pale and thick, flour folded in, baked as fingers at 180C for 12 minutes, cooled, split and filled with vanilla whipped cream piped through the middle.
K: the floating chairs and endless drinks on the cruise ship
Blue raspberry cordial over ice, topped with very cold soda water and a squeeze of lime, served in tall cups with a straw.

s.note: the cooler he uses to carry home his treasures
s.how: Make 4 small ham and cheddar sandwiches with 8 slices white bread, 100g ham and 100g cheddar, and cut into quarters. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon. Pack into a metal lunchbox with 100g cheddar cubes and crackers, a different treasure in each corner.

s.note: the cubes of compacted rubbish he stacks into towers
s.how: Melt 60g butter with 250g marshmallows over low heat. Stir through 150g puffed rice until coated. Press into a lined tray and set for an hour. Cut into neat cubes and stack them into towers.

m.note: the cruise ship where everyone drinks their meals
m.how: Soften an onion with 1 tbsp grated ginger. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 150g red lentils, 400ml coconut milk and 600ml water and simmer 25 minutes, then blitz. Serve in big mugs with a straw, and grilled cheese made from 8 slices sourdough and 150g cheddar on the side.

w.note: the little sponge cake he finds in the rubbish
w.how: Whisk 3 eggs with 100g sugar until pale and thick, then fold in 100g flour. Pipe 12 fingers onto a lined tray and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Cool, split and pipe in 200ml cream whipped with vanilla.

d.note: the floating chairs and endless drinks on the cruise ship
d.how: Fill four tall cups with ice. Add 40ml blue raspberry cordial to each, top with very cold soda water and squeeze in some lime. Add a straw and recline.
